output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the total supply overflows, allowing the owner to set the balance of any arbitrary user to any arbitrary value.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the balance overflows, allowing attackers to make the balance of a target user arbitrarily large.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the balance or allowance overflows, allowing attackers to make the balance of a target user arbitrarily large.
The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It does not check if the allowance overflows, allowing attackers to set the allowance of a target user to any arbitrary value.
The mintToken function has a wrong logic vulnerability. It does not check if the total supply overflows, allowing the owner to set the balance of any arbitrary user to any arbitrary value.
